notes:
Product: JetBrains plugins (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that ship a local indexer + on-device code completions. Primary differentiator is file-system aware indexing and background incremental updates.

Summary of needs: low-latency streaming (token-by-token UI), ability to pin model versions per-release channel, local (on-disk) index caching to avoid repeated heavy compute, deterministic completions for CI-enabled code-gen checks, per-workspace privacy controls.

Security/controls: many customers (fintech / healthcare) demand on-prem or VPC deployment, strict audit logs, and KMS integration. They asked about retention controls and support for SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning.

Commercial asks: flexible billing (per-seat vs org), discount for ISV bundling, ability to white-label SDK for resale.

Quotes from calls: "Want streaming completions that don't block the IDE — sub-50ms round trips for local model inference and sub-150ms for hosted with smart fallback"; "If Redwood can offer a compact quantized model and a simple on-prem installer, procurement moves fast."

POC notes: we installed Redwood edge runtime on test macOS and Linux VMs. Observed good throughput on g4dn-equivalent, but memory for index + kv cache spikes on large monorepos. SE recommended model quantization and prefix caching.

Risk: legal asked if we can support air-gapped installs for bank pilot (likely Private deployment).

public_summary: Pegasus IDE Forge builds JetBrains plugins focused on low-latency code completion and local workspace indexing. They are in an evaluation-stage POC with Redwood to validate streaming latency, model pinning, and on-prem deployment options for regulated customers.
